content.short: Stratium offers structured products on Hyperliquid including volatility perps and asset baskets.
content.description: Stratium builds structured products on Hyperliquid, including perpetuals on volatility itself and baskets that give exposure to a group of assets in one position. Trading volatility directly is normally the preserve of options desks, and packaging it as a perp makes the exposure reachable without an options book.
content.meta: Volatility perpetuals and asset baskets, putting options-desk exposure within reach.
